Generate custom graphrag prompts with your own data (i.e. auto templating).

Usage: graphloom prompt-tune [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -r, --root <ROOT>
          Project root directory

          [default: .]

  -v, --verbose
          Run the prompt tuning pipeline with verbose logging

      --domain <DOMAIN>
          The domain your input data is related to. For example 'space science', 'microbiology', 'environmental news'. If not defined, a domain will be inferred from the input data.

      --selection-method <SELECTION_METHOD>
          The text chunk selection method.

          Possible values:
          - top:    Select the first `limit` chunks in document order
          - random: Select `limit` chunks uniformly at random
          - auto:   Select chunks closest to the embedding centroid

          [default: random]

      --n-subset-max <N_SUBSET_MAX>
          The number of text chunks to embed when --selection-method=auto.

          [default: 300]

      --k <K>
          The maximum number of documents to select from each centroid when --selection-method=auto.

          [default: 15]

      --limit <LIMIT>
          The number of documents to load when --selection-method={random,top}.

          [default: 15]

      --max-tokens <MAX_TOKENS>
          The max token count for prompt generation.

          [default: 2000]

      --min-examples-required <MIN_EXAMPLES_REQUIRED>
          The minimum number of examples to generate/include in the entity extraction prompt.

          [default: 2]

      --chunk-size <CHUNK_SIZE>
          The size of each example text chunk. Overrides chunking.size in the configuration file.

          [default: 1200]

      --overlap <OVERLAP>
          The overlap size for chunking documents. Overrides chunking.overlap in the configuration file.

          [default: 100]

      --language <LANGUAGE>
          The primary language used for inputs and outputs in graphrag prompts.

      --discover-entity-types
          Discover and extract unspecified entity types.

      --no-discover-entity-types
          Skip entity-type discovery and generate untyped extraction templates.

  -o, --output <OUTPUT>
          The directory to save prompts to, relative to the project root directory.

          [default: prompts]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
